CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_adjust(p_user_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_type text, p_reason text, p_admin_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_account_id UUID;
    v_new_balance INT;
    v_ledger_id UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT id INTO v_account_id
    FROM public.credit_accounts
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_account_id IS NULL THEN
        INSERT INTO public.credit_accounts (user_id, balance, reserved_balance, total_earned)
        VALUES (p_user_id, GREATEST(0, p_amount), 0, GREATEST(0, p_amount))
        RETURNING id, balance INTO v_account_id, v_new_balance;
    ELSE
        UPDATE public.credit_accounts
        SET balance = GREATEST(0, balance + p_amount),
            total_earned = CASE WHEN p_amount > 0 THEN total_earned + p_amount ELSE total_earned END,
            updated_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_account_id
        RETURNING balance INTO v_new_balance;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.credit_ledger (
        account_id,
        user_id,
        amount,
        balance_after,
        transaction_type,
        reason,
        admin_id
    ) VALUES (
        v_account_id,
        p_user_id,
        p_amount,
        v_new_balance,
        p_type,
        p_reason,
        p_admin_id
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_ledger_id;

    RETURN v_ledger_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_consume(p_user_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_task text, p_job_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_account_id UUID;
    v_balance INT;
    v_reserved INT;
    v_ledger_id UUID;
BEGIN
    SELECT id, balance, reserved_balance INTO v_account_id, v_balance, v_reserved
    FROM public.credit_accounts
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_account_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Credit account not found for user %', p_user_id;
    END IF;

    IF p_amount > 0 THEN
        IF v_reserved >= p_amount THEN
            -- Consume from reservation
            UPDATE public.credit_accounts
            SET reserved_balance = reserved_balance - p_amount,
                total_used = total_used + p_amount,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = v_account_id;
        ELSE
            -- Consume directly from balance if not reserved
            IF (v_balance + v_reserved) < p_amount THEN
                RAISE EXCEPTION 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS for consumption';
            END IF;

            UPDATE public.credit_accounts
            SET balance = balance - (p_amount - v_reserved),
                reserved_balance = 0,
                total_used = total_used + p_amount,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = v_account_id;
        END IF;

        INSERT INTO public.credit_ledger (
            account_id,
            user_id,
            amount,
            balance_after,
            transaction_type,
            task,
            job_id,
            metadata
        ) VALUES (
            v_account_id,
            p_user_id,
            -p_amount,
            v_balance,
            'AI_USAGE',
            p_task,
            p_job_id,
            p_metadata
        ) RETURNING id INTO v_ledger_id;
    END IF;

    RETURN v_ledger_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.credit_reserve(p_user_id uuid, p_amount integer, p_task text, p_metadata jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_balance INT;
    v_account_id UUID;
    v_ledger_id UUID;
BEGIN
    IF p_amount <= 0 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Reserve amount must be greater than zero';
    END IF;

    -- Lock credit account for update
    SELECT id, balance INTO v_account_id, v_balance
    FROM public.credit_accounts
    WHERE user_id = p_user_id
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF v_account_id IS NULL THEN
        -- Auto-create account if missing
        INSERT INTO public.credit_accounts (user_id, balance, reserved_balance, total_earned)
        VALUES (p_user_id, 100, 0, 100)
        RETURNING id, balance INTO v_account_id, v_balance;
    END IF;

    IF v_balance < p_amount THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS: Required %, Available %', p_amount, v_balance;
    END IF;

    -- Update balances
    UPDATE public.credit_accounts
    SET balance = balance - p_amount,
        reserved_balance = reserved_balance + p_amount,
        updated_at = now()
    WHERE id = v_account_id;

    -- Append to ledger
    INSERT INTO public.credit_ledger (
        account_id,
        user_id,
        amount,
        balance_after,
        transaction_type,
        task,
        metadata
    ) VALUES (
        v_account_id,
        p_user_id,
        -p_amount,
        v_balance - p_amount,
        'RESERVATION',
        p_task,
        p_metadata
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_ledger_id;

    RETURN v_ledger_id;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.execute_exam_switch_atomic(p_user_id uuid, p_switch_request_id uuid, p_razorpay_payment_id text, p_razorpay_order_id text, p_razorpay_signature text DEFAULT NULL::text, p_amount numeric DEFAULT 2.00, p_currency text DEFAULT 'USD'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_req public.exam_switch_requests%ROWTYPE;
  v_profile public.profiles%ROWTYPE;
  v_from_name TEXT;
  v_to_name TEXT;
  v_history_id UUID;
  v_existing_payment_switch UUID;
BEGIN
  -- 1. Lock switch request row for update
  SELECT * INTO v_req
  FROM public.exam_switch_requests
  WHERE id = p_switch_request_id AND user_id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_req.id IS NULL THEN
    -- Try resolving by razorpay_order_id if switch request id not passed
    IF p_razorpay_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      SELECT * INTO v_req
      FROM public.exam_switch_requests
      WHERE razorpay_order_id = p_razorpay_order_id AND user_id = p_user_id
      FOR UPDATE;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  IF v_req.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Exam switch request not found for this user.'
    );
  END IF;

  -- 2. Idempotency check: If already completed, return existing success state
  IF v_req.status = 'switch_completed' THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', true,
      'is_duplicate', true,
      'message', 'Exam switch already finalized.',
      'from_exam_id', v_req.from_exam_id,
      'to_exam_id', v_req.to_exam_id,
      'completed_at', v_req.completed_at
    );
  END IF;

  -- 3. Prevent Replay Attack: Verify payment ID hasn't been used in another completed switch
  IF p_razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT id INTO v_existing_payment_switch
    FROM public.exam_switch_history
    WHERE payment_reference = p_razorpay_payment_id;

    IF v_existing_payment_switch IS NOT NULL THEN
      RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'success', false,
        'error', 'Payment reference has already been redeemed for an exam switch.'
      );
    END IF;
  END IF;

  -- 4. Lock Profile
  SELECT * INTO v_profile
  FROM public.profiles
  WHERE id = p_user_id
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF v_profile.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'User profile not found.'
    );
  END IF;

  -- 5. Validate exams
  IF v_req.from_exam_id = v_req.to_exam_id THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Source and target exams cannot be identical.'
    );
  END IF;

  SELECT name INTO v_from_name FROM public.exams WHERE id = v_req.from_exam_id;
  SELECT name INTO v_to_name FROM public.exams WHERE id = v_req.to_exam_id;

  IF v_to_name IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
      'success', false,
      'error', 'Target exam does not exist in registry.'
    );
  END IF;

  -- 6. Perform the atomic update on public.profiles
  UPDATE public.profiles
  SET current_exam_id = v_req.to_exam_id,
      exam_locked = TRUE,
      exam_selected_at = NOW(),
      exam_switch_count = COALESCE(exam_switch_count, 0) + 1,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_user_id;

  -- 7. Upsert user_exams for the new target exam (WITHOUT deleting previous exam data!)
  INSERT INTO public.user_exams (user_id, exam_id, status, target_score, created_at)
  VALUES (p_user_id, v_req.to_exam_id, 'in_progress', 85.0, NOW())
  ON CONFLICT (user_id, exam_id) DO UPDATE
  SET status = 'in_progress';

  -- 8. Record in exam_switch_history
  INSERT INTO public.exam_switch_history (
    user_id,
    from_exam_id,
    to_exam_id,
    amount,
    currency,
    payment_reference,
    switch_request_id,
    switched_at
  ) VALUES (
    p_user_id,
    v_req.from_exam_id,
    v_req.to_exam_id,
    COALESCE(p_amount, v_req.amount),
    COALESCE(p_currency, v_req.currency),
    COALESCE(p_razorpay_payment_id, p_razorpay_order_id, 'manual_admin'),
    v_req.id,
    NOW()
  ) RETURNING id INTO v_history_id;

  -- 9. Update the switch request
  UPDATE public.exam_switch_requests
  SET status = 'switch_completed',
      razorpay_payment_id = COALESCE(p_razorpay_payment_id, razorpay_payment_id),
      razorpay_signature = COALESCE(p_razorpay_signature, razorpay_signature),
      completed_at = NOW(),
      metadata = jsonb_build_object(
        'history_id', v_history_id,
        'from_exam_name', v_from_name,
        'to_exam_name', v_to_name
      )
  WHERE id = v_req.id;

  -- 10. Record in general payments table if razorpay_payment_id exists
  IF p_razorpay_payment_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.payments (
      user_id,
      amount,
      currency,
      razorpay_payment_id,
      razorpay_order_id,
      razorpay_signature,
      status,
      webhook_payload,
      created_at
    ) VALUES (
      p_user_id,
      COALESCE(p_amount, 2.00),
      COALESCE(p_currency, 'USD'),
      p_razorpay_payment_id,
      p_razorpay_order_id,
      p_razorpay_signature,
      'captured',
      jsonb_build_object('type', 'exam_switch', 'from', v_from_name, 'to', v_to_name),
      NOW()
    ) ON CONFLICT (razorpay_payment_id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'success', true,
    'message', 'Exam switched successfully to ' || v_to_name,
    'from_exam_id', v_req.from_exam_id,
    'from_exam_name', v_from_name,
    'to_exam_id', v_req.to_exam_id,
    'to_exam_name', v_to_name,
    'switch_count', COALESCE(v_profile.exam_switch_count, 0) + 1,
    'history_id', v_history_id
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_public_mcq_by_slug(p_slug text)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, slug text, question text, options jsonb, difficulty text, explanation text, clinical_pearl text, exam_id uuid, exam_name text, exam_slug text, subject_id uuid, subject_name text, topic_id uuid, topic_name text, created_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 
    m.id,
    m.slug,
    m.question,
    m.options,
    m.difficulty,
    m.explanation,
    m.clinical_pearl,
    m.exam_id,
    e.name AS exam_name,
    e.slug AS exam_slug,
    m.subject_id,
    es.name AS subject_name,
    m.topic_id,
    et.name AS topic_name,
    m.created_at
  FROM public.mcqs m
  LEFT JOIN public.exams e ON m.exam_id = e.id
  LEFT JOIN public.exam_subjects es ON m.subject_id = es.id
  LEFT JOIN public.exam_topics et ON m.topic_id = et.id
  WHERE m.slug = p_slug
    AND m.status = 'approved'
    AND m.visibility IN ('PUBLIC_CANONICAL', 'PUBLIC_DISCOVERABLE');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_role_id UUID;
BEGIN
  -- Insert profile
  INSERT INTO public.profiles (id, auth_user_id, email, first_name, last_name, avatar_url)
  VALUES (
    NEW.id,
    NEW.id,
    NEW.email,
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'first_name', split_part(NEW.email, '@', 1)),
    COALESCE(NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'last_name', ''),
    NEW.raw_user_meta_data->>'avatar_url'
  )
  ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
    email = EXCLUDED.email,
    updated_at = NOW();

  -- Get canonical 'user' role ID
  SELECT id INTO v_role_id FROM public.roles WHERE name = 'user';

  -- Explicitly assign default user role
  IF v_role_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    INSERT INTO public.user_roles (user_id, role_id)
    VALUES (NEW.id, v_role_id)
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, role_id) DO NOTHING;
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.has_permission(p_user_id uuid, p_permission_name text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_has_perm BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM public.user_roles ur
    JOIN public.role_permissions rp ON ur.role_id = rp.role_id
    JOIN public.permissions p ON rp.permission_id = p.id
    WHERE ur.user_id = p_user_id AND p.name = p_permission_name
  ) INTO v_has_perm;
  
  RETURN v_has_perm;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_is_admin BOOLEAN := FALSE;
BEGIN
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM public.user_roles ur
    JOIN public.roles r ON ur.role_id = r.id
    WHERE ur.user_id = p_user_id AND r.name IN ('super_admin', 'admin')
  ) INTO v_is_admin;
  
  RETURN v_is_admin;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.promote_ugc_to_canonical(p_mcq_id uuid, p_admin_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_admin(p_admin_id) THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', false, 'error', 'Unauthorized: Admin authorization required');
  END IF;

  UPDATE public.mcqs
  SET visibility = 'PUBLIC_CANONICAL',
      status = 'approved',
      reviewed = true,
      reviewed_by = p_admin_id,
      reviewed_at = NOW()
  WHERE id = p_mcq_id;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('success', true, 'message', 'Content promoted to PUBLIC_CANONICAL');
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.record_payment_event(p_provider text, p_event_id text, p_event_type text, p_payload_hash text, p_payload jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_existing public.payment_events%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
    SELECT * INTO v_existing
    FROM public.payment_events
    WHERE provider = p_provider AND provider_event_id = p_event_id;

    IF v_existing.id IS NOT NULL THEN
        RETURN jsonb_build_object(
            'is_duplicate', true,
            'event_id', v_existing.id,
            'status', v_existing.status,
            'processed_at', v_existing.processed_at
        );
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO public.payment_events (
        provider,
        provider_event_id,
        event_type,
        payload_hash,
        payload,
        status
    ) VALUES (
        p_provider,
        p_event_id,
        p_event_type,
        p_payload_hash,
        p_payload,
        'processing'
    ) RETURNING id INTO v_existing.id;

    RETURN jsonb_build_object(
        'is_duplicate', false,
        'event_id', v_existing.id,
        'status', 'processing'
    );
END;
$function$
